newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Canberra sees no quick jobless turnaround.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Canberra sees no quick jobless turnaround.

text.p: Australian Employment Minister Amanda Vanstone said on Friday she did not expect an immediate turnaround in unemployment.
"I wouldn't foresee any immediate turnaround in unemployment ... it's a rock solid problem," Vanstone told Seven Network television.
Official data released on Thursday showed the jobless rate increased to 8.8 percent in August from 8.5 percent in July.
Vanstone urged the Labor opposition and minor parties which hold the balance of power in the upper house of parliament, the Senate, to not to block the government's labour market reforms.
Failure to implement the reform package, which reduces union involvement in favour of individual contracts, would hamper efforts to reduce unemployment, Vanstone said.
Vanstone again refused to set a target for unemployment by the end of the government's three-year term, in 1999.
The Liberal-National government, in its 1996/97 budget released last month, forecast unemployment to fall to 8.25 percent by the June quarter of 1997.
